current.text: Joe projects Wells as a reserve, possibly the first player off the bench, playing 20 to 25 minutes. He is not in Joe's projected starting five.
Memphis has a very deep roster with crowded guard and forward groups. Coach Tuomas Iisalo runs an 11-man rotation.
Joe expects only Cameron Boozer and Cedric Coward to top 30 minutes for Memphis, which caps Wells' minutes.
